items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Yeah, I'll find one right next to Nick's block.

ctx.x: Oh, before they buried the man? Or when they were going to get the body or something like that? Yeah. Oh, they played ball was all hymns. I mean all the hymns, I mean like of course the walk with the ear, you think like that, I mean just a little while to stay here. Just a while to stay here. I mean it's always appropriate to play it when you're going to get the body when you're right in the block of the body. That's a nice hymn. I like that hymn very much. Yeah, just a little while to stay here. I mean it's like…
Do you think you could get one that was in the class of the Owen Wood band? Oh, I think I could. Do you find a baritone player? Yeah, I'll find one right next to Nick's block. Can he still play?
Oh, Adolph? Yeah. Adolph Alexander? Sure, he'll play. I stroked in there in that pad, huh? Sure, he's all right now. Yeah.
